text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament adopts the ninth development plan 1997-2001.
- Parliament adopts law on a loan accord from Export-Import Bank of Japan to lend Tunisia 10 billion yen (about 95 million dinars) to support the Tunisian private sector.
- President Ben Ali tells governors at end of their annual meeting to speed up modernization programme for small and medium firms.
- Tunisia aims for an average 10 percent growth rate in the export sector, to 5.91 million dinars, in 1997.
